claim_scope: What one subject calls that the ontology does not model. A candidate list, not an ontology.
subject: nodegoat
reading: 18 of 175 distinct call names are modelled, covering 12% of the calls. That number is not a score: most of what any program calls is not security-relevant, and a high share would mean the tables were too loose. It is a baseline to move deliberately.

leads_it_found.res.render: 23 calls, five in a method that reads untrusted input, and the highest-ranked product candidate. Task 14.3 reasoned its way to this same gap by hand and declined to model it as a flow sink because template escaping is a property of the engine's configuration. The instrument found it in one run, which is the validation that matters.
leads_it_found.Math.random: 7 calls in app/data/user-dao.js. Weak randomness is a weakness class this ontology has no family for at all, so no census could have surfaced it: the family list itself is the blind spot. This is the kind of gap only a coverage instrument finds.
leads_it_found.parseInt: 9 calls, one near a source. A coercion, and the JavaScript sanitizer list has no coercion entry while Python's has five.
leads_it_found.app.post and app.use: route registration, near untrusted input, and the place middleware guards are attached
leads_it_found.db.collection: the accessor whose result carries the operations the access-control family models

noise_it_had_to_be_taught_to_drop.synthesised_names: `_tmp_3.push` and `__ecma.Array.factory` were the two most frequent candidates in the first run. They are how the frontend lowers a destructuring and an array literal, not names the code calls.
noise_it_had_to_be_taught_to_drop.tests_and_build_scripts: A Cypress suite and a Gruntfile held four of the five most frequent remaining candidates. Ranked together with product code they would have buried the two real leads.

limits: The `file` and `line` on a candidate are its first occurrence, which misleads when one name is called from several files; the distinct-spelling count is reported beside it.
One subject, one language. The instrument says nothing about whether a candidate is security-relevant; that judgement is the point of requiring provenance before an entry.
Coverage share counts calls, not findings. A name modelled but never reached contributes to the share and nothing else.
